load_llff_dataset: load an LLFF dataset from a directory with poses, bounds, and camera intrinsics
minify_images: downscale images in an LLFF dataset directory by a specified factor or resolution
recenter_poses: recenter camera poses to their average position for consistent scene coordinate system
spherify_poses: convert camera poses to a spherical path for 360 degree scene rendering
render_spiral_path: generate a spiral camera path for novel view synthesis rendering
